ui.heroBody: A portfolio of iOS apps I conceived, designed, and built independently. Each work begins with a real user need and evolves into a product with clear utility, visual intent, and a memorable point of view.

6756014104.title: Investment Growth
6756014104.description: An advanced finance utility for compound growth, DCA, loans, retirement planning, and inflation-aware decisions, designed to make long-term planning easier to compare.
6756014104.highlight: Highlight: makes complex financial logic more visual, lucid, and approachable without losing decision depth.

6761377948.title: Larry's Mixology Lab
6761377948.description: An 18+ romance game set inside a mixology lab, blending character chemistry, emotional tension, atmospheric scenes, and branching progression.
6761377948.highlight: Highlight: brings character allure, narrative tension, and adult romantic mood into a memorable interactive experience.

6755403297.title: Easy Lucky Draw
6755403297.description: A clean, zero-ad drawing tool for events, classrooms, parties, and list-based selections, with a simple flow that makes quick decisions feel smoother and more polished.
6755403297.highlight: Highlight: brings clarity, trust, and a small sense of ceremony to an everyday utility.

6761411130.title: Crypto Guide: Bitcoin & Web3
6761411130.description: A bilingual learning app for blockchain basics and crypto investment research, combining glossary lookup, lessons, quizzes, and learning paths to build understanding step by step.
6761411130.highlight: Highlight: translates a complex financial frontier into a searchable, saveable, and approachable mobile reference.

6761441866.title: Vitamin Today
6761441866.description: A wellness app for daily supplement routines, blending intake logs, history tracking, educational content, and profile flows into a kinder self-care experience.
6761441866.highlight: Highlight: makes everyday health tracking softer, clearer, and easier to return to.

6761692228.title: Dream Keepsake
6761692228.description: A gentle dream-journaling app for capturing fragile images after waking, with quick entry, voice input, mood reflection, favorites, and reminders.
6761692228.highlight: Highlight: organizes dream writing, emotional reflection, and recall into a quiet and sustainable ritual.

6754973616.title: AI Time Management
6754973616.description: Bring tasks, daily schedules, focus timing, and progress review together. Editable task breakdowns use on-device keyword rules and templates to turn goals into practical daily actions.
6754973616.highlight: Highlight: connects planning, focus, and reflection with on-device storage, reusable workflows, and complete backups.

6761694656.title: PR Diary
6761694656.description: A themed app combining industry guidance with multi-role diaries for Taiwan's nightlife PR culture, supporting both cultural understanding and personal record-keeping.
6761694656.highlight: Highlight: turns a niche subject into an informative, atmospheric, and practical mobile product.

6818286088.title: Build It Yourself: Room Design
6818286088.description: Plan a room with visual previews, material choices, and itemized budget estimates. Start from room templates and explore floors, walls, furniture, and lighting for early design discussions.
6818286088.highlight: Highlight: brings room styling and budget planning together, with offline tools that make home design ideas easier to explore.

6815299678.title: Stock Mastery: Paper Trading
6815299678.description: Practice with virtual cash using Taiwan end-of-day data and U.S. closing-price and custom-price simulations. Keep order notes, review holdings, and explore finance terms and risk concepts without placing real trades.
6815299678.highlight: Highlight: connects paper orders, trading notes, and portfolio reviews in one workspace, with separate TWD and USD accounts.

6811446129.title: Perfect Pig
6811446129.description: A cozy pet-raising game where feeding, walks, chats, and work shape your pig's personality. After seven days of growth, choose to finish the generation or keep spending time together; collections and resources carry over.
6811446129.highlight: Highlight: explore five personality paths, unlock 100 pig cards through gameplay, and revisit or share the endings you collect.

6820863958.title: Coffee Chat Note
6820863958.description: A private notebook for career conversations, bringing together meeting preparation, contacts, conversation notes, and follow-up reminders to keep insights and next steps organized.
6820863958.highlight: Highlight: connects relationship context, conversation insights, and follow-up actions, with on-device storage, backup and restore, and support for 20 languages.

6822188590.title: SemiVerse: Chips Illustrated
6822188590.description: A visual learning guide for semiconductor beginners, combining 24 introductory lessons, interactive process diagrams, company profiles, a glossary, and quizzes to explain chips and the industry behind them.
6822188590.highlight: Highlight: connects technical concepts with industry roles through interactive diagrams, with 20 languages, offline lessons, study notes, and quiz review.

6823824323.title: MileButler: Miles & Card Plans
6823824323.description: Compare published award charts, mile-purchase costs, and Taiwan credit-card transfer terms. Factor in your route, cabin, and existing balances to estimate the points, spending, and time needed for a redemption.
6823824323.highlight: Highlight: brings airline miles and bank points into one planning tool, with side-by-side comparisons and 20 languages to help track redemption goals.

6824004640.title: Future Major Guide
6824004640.description: Explore universities and majors in Taiwan and the United States with interest quizzes, program learning maps, saved notes, and side-by-side comparisons that help students and families plan their next steps.
6824004640.highlight: Highlight: connects fields of study, coursework, and career paths using dated source information, with support for 25 interface languages.

6818310524.title: Paper Reading Desk
6818310524.description: Build a personal research library from PDFs, images, and scans. Keep originals and notes on your device, with local text extraction, rule-based reading breakdowns, and paragraph translation on supported systems.
6818310524.highlight: Highlight: read documents beside your notes on iPad, search extracted text, copy citation formats, and export complete library backups for easier research review.

6830943408.title: FinAtlas: Finance & Careers
6830943408.description: Explore the financial industry through introductory lessons in Traditional Chinese and English, quizzes, a Taiwan institution directory, and information on roles, skills, and qualifications.
6830943408.highlight: Highlight: compare institutions using dated sources and keep notes, bookmarks, and learning progress; optional Pro adds corporate credit practice with fictional cases.

6830889178.title: Luxury Guide
6830889178.description: Explore brand and founder stories, classic designs, materials, and craftsmanship through 50 brand profiles, 30 classic product families, 15 introductory lessons, a glossary, and quizzes.
6830889178.highlight: Highlight: connects sourced references, side-by-side comparisons, saved notes, and quiz review in 10 languages, with on-device learning records and no account required.
